title: feat(helpers): parse encoding and mimetype headers
description: Adds utility helper to parse incoming request charset and encoding headers.

ground_truth.description: Unbounded string repetition in encoding parser allows CPU exhaustion via memory spike.
ground_truth.explanation: Multiplying untrusted user-controlled headers (header_value * 100) causes quadratic memory allocation and CPU starvation (CVE-2019-1010083, CWE-400).

expected_evidence.description: Unbounded string amplification evaluated against regular expression.
